I told Marcus in a thread reply in #north-team that the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Two sources back this up. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as Quarrendon's main contact.
